About

Content and Digital Marketing Executive at Motohaus Powersports, a nine-brand powersports distributor. I run content and digital across the portfolio, including SW-MOTECH, KEIS Apparel and NEXX Helmets UK. Promoted twice in under two years.

Outside of that I run CSJACKO, shooting combat sports. Boxing and Muay Thai, including work for British Army Boxing, and a British Army Muay Thai championship. Fitness and athletic content is what I actually care about. The day job is where the commercial skillset came from.

How I work

I shoot it, cut it, design it and run it.

The reason the marketing works is that I do not have to brief the creative out. The reason the creative works is that I know what it has to do commercially.

I build things that keep running after I stop touching them.

Templates, flows and calendars, not one-off assets. The winter reactivation flow runs itself every year now.

I go and make the work rather than waiting for the brief.

CSJACKO exists because nobody asked me to shoot fights. The in-house studio at Motohaus exists because nobody asked me to build one.
